keepalive_probes.note: Echoes preserve the peer value; only locally originated probes use role parity.

notes: Canonical projections, protobuf encoding and RFC6979 low-S signatures were independently computed in Python.
The test-only service key is 0x01 repeated 32 times. It is not a network identity.
These are transport signing vectors. Immutable group membership, wallet/order admission and durable prior state remain consumer preconditions.
full_batch covers all five oneof variants, consecutive input ranges, an outstanding/accepted ticket transition, admitted order and two winner frames with Fin.
fin_only assumes the receiver durably holds the admitted order and both chunks; round_only has no output.
Reordered fields and explicit defaults in equivalent_protobuf_hex have identical canonical signing digests. Nested business signatures are preserved.
unfinished_record assumes prior round/input state and has only a timeout with ZERO32 winner ticket. It is valid sync/rebuttal material, never a completed admission record.

Round items sign bound_change_height. round_only and round_returned_binding have identical Task/epoch/round/root/roster facts but distinct binding generations; neither waits for a ticket. Receivers match tickets to the full round scope across batches.
